method: Whole-file manual reading of Japanese catalog; pinned bytes reverified; v91 structural parity retained.
findings: Probable duplicate caption 重複候補 explicitly means duplicate candidates; hash prefix and sampled hash remain explicit. Large-file option says sparse hash over64MiB, not full-content equality.

Recovery completion requests verifying file data; recoverable versus possibly recoverable states remain separate. Changed source metadata requests rescan and same-volume restoration warns of overwriting deleted data.
Sparse action スパースファイルを作成 says create a sparse file, which can obscure conversion of an existing selected file. Compression remains separate; hardlinks, symlinks and junctions have distinct labels.
Many mnemonic suffixes use parenthesized Latin letters, while graph algorithm names retain ampersands inside Latin names. Text reading does not qualify native/custom menu routing or conflicts.
Hidden attribute label says hidden file although also used in directory exclusion context. Permanent deletion wording does not prove secure erasure; cloud warning explicitly describes download risk.

Logical/physical sizes, binary units, cleanup tokens and ordered permissions remain explicit. Account caption uses principal rather than generic account. MSI ja-JP/1041/932 needs separate encoding and installer checks.
limits: No native-speaker certification, rendered Japanese UI, mnemonic conflict, font fit, installer or Windows runtime verified. No foreign production code adopted.
Native pHash investigation deferred; completed repository count remains147/500.
